# Confidential Transfers (Python)

Example code for confidential transfers of Multi-Purpose Tokens (MPTs) on devnet with [xrpl-py](https://github.com/XRPLF/xrpl-py).

## Setup

```sh
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

## Issue an MPT for confidential transfers

```sh
python issue_confidential_mpt.py
```

## Claw back a confidential balance

```sh
python clawback_confidential_mpt.py
```
